audit.rule: A: either A/B >=20% all-bucket eligible direction conflicts. B: old A<=3/9,new A>=7/9 and provenance mismatch or increased boundary median. B takes priority.

labels.denominator: All near frames whose rerendered zero-velocity and pre-acceleration axis expectations are both nonzero; zero/invalid cases counted separately.
labels.interpretation: Direction conflicts against a new-render same-state teacher are associations. Historical finite-difference velocity replay compatibility is separately recorded, not asserted causal proof.
labels.teacher_inputs: Actual new-render RGB-D observations at every near source state; no fabricated visibility or fit quality.

consistency.provenance_scope: OCT overlay was freshly rendered with the new quality; training uses original stored RGB paths. Different render provenance is established; exact pixel disagreement for all frames is not claimed.

replay.label_rule: Only zero-velocity/pre-acceleration-reversed axes whose finite-difference history replay reproduces reversal. Other axes and executed-action history unchanged.
replay.original_pool: All unmodified valid windows of merged base dataset, 92%; independent repaired replay 8%.

best.metric_scope: User-authorized development fast5 or dev20; strict success is diagnostic only.

V0_step2000.metric_scope: User-authorized development fast5 or dev20; strict success is diagnostic only.

V0_step4000.metric_scope: User-authorized development fast5 or dev20; strict success is diagnostic only.

phase3.improvement_reference: New checkpoints paired under identical full1600 protocol. Historical old runs are contextual, not silently reused as matched new-protocol baseline.

phase4.reason: Phase3 finalmean<35um and late drift<15um gate failed
